originalTitle: Tough Call | D.Mon Hero Trailer | Overwatch
content: Every hero needs a squad, and every squad needs a leader. Watch as D.Mon and the MEKA Squad go up against Wrecking Ball and the Junkers in our newest Hero Trailer, Tough Call. And join her on the battlefield as our next Tank Hero when Season 4 starts Aug 11.
